corrections_applied.finding: f_var(yhat_solar) function was mathematically undefined in the existing architecture.
corrections_applied.resolution: Class A specification status marked INCOMPLETE pending formal definition of the forecast variance calculation function.

corrections_applied.finding: Proposed startup penalty w_hyst * sum(v_start,t) was a startup cost penalty, not hysteresis or minimum runtime.
corrections_applied.resolution: Reframed Class C explicitly as 'Additional Startup Cost Penalty Intervention' with exact MILP objective coefficient modification c[base+14] = c_start + w_start_penalty.
Defined T_daylight deterministically from forecast as T_daylight = { t | P_solar,gen,t > 0.0 W }, covering polar day (all 24h) and polar night (empty set).

corrections_applied.finding: gamma^t discounted entire objective including critical load penalty.
corrections_applied.resolution: Explicitly decomposed objective terms: gamma^t applies to fuel, startup, degradation, and curtailment, while critical load unmet penalty c[base+9] remains UNWEIGHTED.

corrections_applied.finding: Operating cases of coupling equation required explicit derivation.
corrections_applied.resolution: Derived operating cases: Case 1 (u_diesel=0 -> SOC >= SOC_min + lambda*100%), imposing higher reserve floor when diesel is OFF; Case 2 (u_diesel=1 -> SOC >= SOC_min), reverting to standard floor when diesel is ON.

corrections_applied.finding: P_unmet = 0 was incorrectly described as a MILP hard linear constraint.
corrections_applied.resolution: Corrected source classification: P_unmet = 0 is an objective-penalized decision variable in MILP (w_unmet = 10.0 $/Wh) and a hard safety invariant in evaluation/verification.
